covered.title: Updates
covered.text: Core, theme, plugin and dependency updates, tested before they reach your live site.

covered.title: Security patches
covered.text: Vulnerabilities patched promptly, with security checks built into every round of updates.

covered.title: Backups
covered.text: Regular backups of your files and data, kept separate from your live server and ready to restore.

covered.title: Uptime monitoring
covered.text: Your site is monitored for uptime and issues, so we hear about outages early and act fast.

covered.title: Performance checks
covered.text: Periodic speed and Core Web Vitals reviews, with fixes when pages start to slow down.

covered.title: Small content and feature changes
covered.text: Text, image and layout updates, plus small feature additions, without starting a new project.

covered.title: Priority support
covered.text: Your requests are handled with priority, with a direct line to the team.

steps.title: Review.
steps.text: We look at your website or app, hosting and current setup to understand what it needs.

steps.title: Choose a plan.
steps.text: We recommend a plan, agree the scope with you and set up backups and monitoring.

steps.title: Ongoing care.
steps.text: Updates, checks and your change requests are handled on a steady, predictable schedule.

steps.title: Clear reporting.
steps.text: You get regular summaries of what was done and what we suggest next.

faq.question: Can you maintain a website you did not build?
faq.answer: Yes, in most cases. We start with a short review of the code, hosting and plugins so we know what we are taking on, and we tell you up front if anything needs fixing first.

faq.question: Which platforms do your care plans cover?
faq.answer: WordPress websites, Shopify stores and custom-built websites and web apps. If your setup is different, tell us about it and we will confirm whether we can look after it.

faq.question: How much does a care plan cost?
faq.answer: Each plan is scoped to your website or app, so we share pricing after the initial review rather than publishing a fixed price list.

faq.question: Can I switch plans later?
faq.answer: Yes. Your needs will change over time, and you can move between plans. We agree how changes work with you before any plan starts.
